regions.merged_text: if read with prayful attention will hardly leave a doubt as to it's supernatural origin. The opposition it has met with from the beginning and this at times positively on the part of Hell and irreligion, ought to be another proof of it's worth in the saving of immortal souls. It's emphatic and reitterated approval on the part of Catholic universities, Bishops and Popes in face of such opposition, as well as it's intrinsic value and manifest harmony with Holy Scriptures, philosophy and sacred theology -- in fact, it's outstanding preeminence in relation to each and all of these, and it's acknowledged climax in asceticism, ought to remove every honest doubt as to the sincerity and candor of the actual writer, as well as to the modesty of her claims, that the work is not her own but that of the peerless Mistress of heavenly wisdom -- under divine guidance, nothing less than the autobiography of the incom- parable Queen of the Universe, Mary, conceived without sin, Virgin Mother of God, -- and think of it! - Our Blessed Mother.
